about: Clarity's defaults, owned by the spec (crates/clarity-spec/src/defaults.rs) and written here once; a runtime that must carry a copy checks it against this file in its own tests. signin: how long a session lasts, how many wrong tries before the sign-in waits and how long it waits (a project's signin may say otherwise; the generators always pass what it says). undoSteps: the steps a window's undo keeps. keptBackups: the automatic backups kept of a database. httpSeconds: how long an http call may take. ownersPerRead: how many records' held lists one read gathers (conformance/held-lists.json). editBusKeeps: the edits a window's edit bus keeps (conformance/edit-bus.json). quietMinutes: how long a browser page may be quiet before a web program lets it go. toastLifespan: how long a toast shows, in milliseconds, when it says no lifespan, and the least and most it may say.
